added_models.model: bb2121 CAR T cytotoxicity against cell lines of quantified BCMA density (in vitro)

efficacy.note: bb2121 killed every BCMA+ line in a receptor-quantified panel, down to ~222 BCMA molecules per cell, implying tumour BCMA level should not select responders.
efficacy.short: Kills cells with very low BCMA
efficacy.quote: Based on receptor quantification, bb2121 recognized tumor cells expressing as little as 222 BCMA molecules per cell.
efficacy.confidence_note: Quote verbatim in the PubMed abstract (PMID 29641319).
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry at the panel's publication; the patient-level reading (BCMA density should not pick responders) is the paper's own claim of activity against all BCMA+ lines.

efficacy.note: In CRB-401, response to ide-cel did not depend on tumour BCMA expression (100% vs 91% at <50% vs >=50% BCMA+ plasma cells), as the low-density cell panel predicted.
efficacy.quote: Response appeared to be independent of tumor BCMA expression, with similarly high response rates observed at tumor BCMA expression levels of less than 50% and 50% or more in patients who received 450×10⁶ CAR+ T cells.
efficacy.confidence_note: Quote from the author manuscript (PMC8202968) read via a page fetch, not the NEJM PDF. Small subgroups at the 450x10^6 dose; response was a secondary end point (primary was safety). CRB-401 (NCT02658929) has no results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.
efficacy.judgement: Patient-level prediction scored on the response-by-BCMA subgroup rather than the primary end point, because the model's claim is about which patients respond; endpoint_role left null. Paired: Raje restates the preclinical claim in its introduction but does not set it beside the subgroup, so comparison_stated false.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: ORR by screening tumour BCMA <50% vs >=50% at 450x10^6 CAR+ T cells (100% vs 91%)

added_models.model: Belantamab PopPK + M-protein tumour-growth + keratopathy Markov simulation framework

dose.note: GSK's integrated PopPK, M-protein tumour-growth and keratopathy Markov simulation framework for belantamab regimens, built to choose doses and schedule extensions.
dose.quote: Integrating models allows simulations that support dosing considerations.
dose.confidence_note: Abstract and full text (PMC13238829) read. First use proxied by publication; component models may be older.
dose.judgement: Opening entry at first public use. The framework was fitted on DREAMM-6/7/8 data, so its comparisons with those trials are retrodictions (next entry).

dose.note: Simulating DREAMM-7/8 protocol dosing reproduced trial VGPR+ (62.0% vs 62.0%; 60.2% vs 68.0%), PFS and grade>=3 eye findings, but on data it was fitted to.
dose.short: Reproduces DREAMM-7/8 on its own data
dose.quote: This framework adequately predicted outcomes from DREAMM‐7/DREAMM‐8, supporting its use to predict benefit‐risk profiles of alternate belantamab mafodotin dosing strategies.
dose.confidence_note: Full text (PMC13238829): M-protein and KVA models include DREAMM-7 and DREAMM-8 patients, and the same data were used for verification.
dose.reason: Retrodiction of the trials it was fitted to
dose.judgement: Scored retro, not same: the trials' results were known (DREAMM-7 and -8 published 2024) and their data were used to build the model. Placed in dose because the framework's purpose is regimen choice; its prospective alternative-regimen predictions remain untested.
dose.magnitude_basis: simulated vs observed VGPR+ rate and grade>=3 ophthalmic exam finding rate (87.5% vs 76.5%; 77.2% vs 82.5%)

considered_not_added: Ide-cel lentiviral integration-site analysis and IL-2-independent growth assay (Abecma SBRA 2021: 'does not preferentially integrate in or near genes of concern for oncogenic transformation'; 'no signs of uncontrolled cellular proliferation'): no product-level comparison. The 2024+ Abecma boxed warning is class-wide ('BCMA- and CD19-directed ... including ABECMA'; 'including CAR-positive tumors'), and the CAR-positive myeloma cases found are after cilta-cel (not a member). No ide-cel CAR+ T-cell malignancy found; the SBRA's 'none ... deemed to be related to the product' at ~1 year follow-up cannot test a years-latency prediction. Re-check if an ide-cel CAR+ case is published.

Xenograft / in-vitro claim that soluble BCMA does not inhibit bb2121 (Friedman 2018: 'consistent with prior reports that anti-BCMA CAR T cells were not inhibited by soluble BCMA protein') vs Abecma SBRA 2021 ('Baseline levels of peripheral soluble BCMA (sBCMA) were negatively corelated with overall response'): a candidate patient-level contra, but the sBCMA observation is on the draft's own NSG xenograft system (bcma-myeloma-xenograft-nsg-cart) and Friedman cites prior reports rather than testing it; left to the draft owner as a patient-level entry on that track.

Vonsetamig (REGN5459) low-CD3-affinity design 'with low cytokine release preclinically' vs phase 1/2 CRS 53.5% (grade 1 46.5%, grade 3 4.7%) (Suvannasankha AACR 2023 CT013, doi 10.1158/1538-7445.AM2023-CT013): the preclinical system (species / assay) is not named in any source found and the abstract itself was paywalled (403); the prediction is relative to high-affinity BCMAxCD3 with no head-to-head. Not added; a lead if Regeneron's preclinical paper is found.

BCMA knockout mice (O'Connor 2004, loss of long-lived marrow plasma cells) vs hypogammaglobulinemia after BCMA depletion: a knockout models loss of BCMA signalling, not killing of BCMA+ cells, so it is not the system that predicts depletion-driven Ig loss; no source compares them.

Belantamab exposure-response analyses (DREAMM-2/7/8; Br J Cancer 2026, Target Oncol 2025, Haematologica 2026) and the sBCMA/M-protein PopPKPD (CPT:PSP 2026): analyses of the trials' own patient data, not model systems with a prior prediction.
Ex vivo patient myeloma cells (belantamab ADCC/killing in Tai 2014; CAR-T product phenotype): no study found using ex vivo sensitivity to predict or select responders for a member drug.

Orva-cel, zevor-cel, P-BCMA-101, BCMA CAR-NK-92: their preclinical systems are BCMA+ xenografts in immunodeficient mice, the system the draft already tracks; no other model with a patient comparison found.
Teclistamab ex vivo EC90 dose model and cilta-cel data: not members of this tile.

Orva-cel EpiMatrix in-silico score (-35.19, 'low immunogenicity risk') and MAPPs vs 44.6% anti-CAR antibodies in EVOLVE (PMC13312103, 2026): an immunogenicity readout with no patient harm (ATA did not affect expansion or PFS), so not one of the four questions; the in-silico run date is not stated and the paper is a post-trial characterisation.
